title: Figure 12: Point contact to exchange-biased spin valve - schematic and resistance data
description: Multi-panel figure: (a) a layer schematic of a point contact on F1/N/F2/AFM/N films, (b) stacked R versus B (mT) hysteresis curves for a series of currents, and (c)-(e) greyscale maps of R versus B for different currents I (mA). The long caption begins 'Figure 12. (a) Schematic of point contact to sample geometry...' and credits Reference 91; text discusses an observation by Wei et al. at room temperature.
